title: Gauravam
desc: Rajinikanth, a seasoned lawyer aiming to become a judge, is outraged when an undeserving candidate is promoted instead. Seeking revenge on the corrupt system, he chooses to defend a murderer.

title: Kotha Bangaru Lokam
desc: Balu falls for his classmate Swapna, a tycoon's daughter. Their love faces trouble when her parents spot their photo in a newspaper and stop her studies.

title: Sarkaru Vaari Paata
desc: Mahi loans a huge sum to his fraudulent lover in Miami and must recover it from her politician father in Vizag. His visit unexpectedly exposes a massive banking scam.

title: Viswasam
desc: Veera Raju, a divorcee, protects his daughter without revealing his identity.

title: RRR
desc: A rebel and an officer unite against dictatorial rulers on a stirring path.

desc: Ravi crosses paths with gangster Bittu and helps the police stop his bank-robbery plan. Humiliated and enraged, Bittu vows revenge and targets Ravi and his family.
